V:
Bulī：The name of a gotta．

They claimed one eighth share of the Buddha’s relics and raised a thūpa over them in their city of Allakappa （D．ii．167）．Their territory was probably near Vethadīpa，because the king of Allakappa is mentioned （DhA．i．161） as being in intimate relationship with the king of Vethadīpa．
